text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The party is surrounded by Maho's plushies on the beach,
signaling the beginning of their battle with the Majimun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夜の海辺で大勢のぬいぐるみに取り囲まれた{0}たち。
マジムンたちとの戦いが始まろうとしていた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: WAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: W-wah?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
わぁっ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Makoto! You're not making any souls drop like that!
Shout from your stomach, not your throat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコト！
　もっとお腹から声を出すさ～！
そんなんじゃ魂を落っことせないよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I know, I know!
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁってるっての！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: RAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: おぉらぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Makoto, Kaori!
There's too many of them!
They'll get us good if we deal with them individually!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはん、
カオリはん！
多勢に無勢や、
いちいち驚かしてたら、
やられてしまうよ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: It's okay to attack them—
text_block_list.orig_text: もう攻撃してでも──

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: No it's not!
text_block_list.orig_text: それはだめだ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: We can't do that!
text_block_list.orig_text: できないよ～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: We've seen you take care of them every single day!
text_block_list.orig_text: 姫さんが毎日大切に手入れしてるの見てるからな！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: We'll save them, and keep them in top shape while we're at it! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: きれいなままで助け出すさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Y'all really are the best, ain't ya?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ほんま、
みんなええ子や。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I oughtta help, too.
Can I leave Arthur and the others to you, my prince?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちも手伝わんと。
王子はん、
アーサーたちを頼めるやろか。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとうな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Maho! They're headed over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホ！
　そっち行ったよ～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Watch out, my prince!
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん、
危ないどす！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Somethin' feels off about that...
How come they went right in his direction?
choice_data_list: Majimun are attracted to benevolent souls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……今の動きは、
変やなぁ？
急に王子はんの方に行きはった……？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
マジムンが狙ってるんは……！

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Now I see.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なるほどなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
The darker it gets, the harder it'll be for us to deal with this.
We oughtta do somethin', and fast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
暗くなってきて、
このままじゃ
不利になるばかりや。
どうにかせんとあかんね。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I planned this trip in the hopes that everyone could relax,
but they've all been helpin' me out instead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなに休暇を
って計画した旅行やのに、
うちが助けられてばっかりや。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: We haven't made any proper summer memories together yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなとの夏の思い出、
全然作られてへん。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
That ain't right.
I'm Caon's guildmaster. It's time I act like it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【自警団（カォン）】のギルドマスターとして、
こんなんじゃあかんよね？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, my prince.
Mind if I have Arthur and co. back?
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん、
預けたばかりで申し訳ないんやけど、
アーサーたちを返してもらえるやろか？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: This!
text_block_list.orig_text: こうするんよっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
?!
Don't rush in on your own, Princess!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！？
　おい姫さん、
何一人で飛び出してんだ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Maho! Watch out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホ！
　危ないよ～！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
These are what you're after, right?
Then come get 'em!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この子たちが欲しいんやろ！？
なら、こっちや！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Ugh! They're all moving together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ、
一斉に……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: We won't make it in time!
text_block_list.orig_text: 間に合わないさ～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear it?
The love I have for you all?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな。
うちの想い、
届いてるやろ？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
If there really are benevolent spirits in you,
then please...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
善い魂が宿ってるんやったら、
どうかお願いや……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Princess!
text_block_list.orig_text: 姫さーーーーーんっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Maho!
text_block_list.orig_text: マホーーーーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
...?
Hey. Something's off here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
　おい、
なんか様子が変だぞ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: The plushies've all stopped in their tracks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬいぐるみたちの動きが、
止まってるさ～？

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Lancelot, Gawain, Arthur!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランスロット、
ガウェイン、
アーサー……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
They're floating...
Hey, what's the deal here?
Didn't we rescue them already?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランスロットたちが浮かんで……
おい、
どうなってんだよ？
あいつらはもう、
解放されたはずだろ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's like they're protecting Maho of their own will!
text_block_list.orig_text: まるでマホを守ってるみたいさ～……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... 
I can hear them. Their voices.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
聞こえてるよ。
みんなの想い。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
They care about me.
Just as much as I care about them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなも、
うちを……
大切やと思ってくれるんやね。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Look!
The Majimun are leaving all the other plushies as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい見ろ！
他のぬいぐるみたちからマジムンが抜けていくぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: They can't control them anymore, so they've got no choice. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
操れなくなったから、
出ていくしかなくなったんだね～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: That settles everything, then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
これで全部……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: No. Not yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
まだどす。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: The Majimun are all gathering up!
text_block_list.orig_text: マジムンが集まっていくさ～！？

text_block_list.name: Majimun
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You gotta be kidding me.
They're turning into one giant monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
集まって……
でっけぇバケモンになりやがった！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: There's mega power coming from it!
text_block_list.orig_text: すごい力を感じるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I can feel my strength being sapped away just through proximity!
Is it trying to steal as many souls as it can?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
近くにいるだけで、
力が抜けていく……！
まさか、
手当たり次第に魂を奪ってやがるのか！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなん、
関係あらしまへん。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Princess?
text_block_list.orig_text: 姫さん？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh. She's angry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホ……
怒ってるさ～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
This thing took my friends and corrupted 'em.
I reckon a li'l bit of payback in is order.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちの大切な仲間を好きにしてくれた、
そのお礼を……
せなあかんね。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
We're lookin' to make some good memories, ain't we?
Takin' this thing down sounds like a fine way of doin' that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくやし
盛大に、
夏の思い出作りを手伝ってもらいましょか。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Let's go all out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
行きますえ！

text_block_list.name: Maho & Makoto & Kaori
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: おー！
